decisions: Trace owns passive 14/20 content with native 8px stack/line gaps and 16px glyphs; running/error/pending are actual optional TraceLine statuses, not operation engines. Native default title Medium versus hover Regular conflicts are retained in evidence; this reference keeps Medium across states to avoid reflow. Error is explicit readable wording, not color alone; metadata retains native 70% opacity and pending the pinned 60% utility. Description may shrink/wrap to remain usable in narrow views, an explicit adaptation of the pinned shrink-0 utility. The delegated primitive owns open/focus/cancellation; native Enter/Space toggles the real trigger and the internal trailing glyph rotates once. The actual inner content wrapper aligns 24px beneath the leading icon/gap. Panel height binds the real primitive --collapsible-panel-height, with explicit 150ms reference motion and reduced-motion disablement. Running shimmer is not essential meaning; this bounded reference keeps stable readable text rather than inventing measured animation from static artwork.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
